description: Static AAA review of the project, no Godot needed: API correctness (Godot 3 code, unknown classes, members and signals, wrong argument counts, missing input actions), performance, code quality and structure. Returns a 0-100 score per category, then one line per finding, `res://file.gd:12: error [rule] message`, and the same as JSON (structuredContent); `detail` full adds each fix. `files` lists only findings in files you changed. `code` + `file` reviews GDScript before you write it. `only_new: true` while fixing: new findings in full, ones you saw as one short line, and how many are fixed. An older 4.x project also gets what changes on the way to 4.7; `from`/`target` set that range. It never changes your code (it keeps the last review in .godot/godotwright/ for only_new and counts rule hits in the local learning file). For errors only the engine finds, run godot_check; godot_checklist lists every rule.

code.description: unsaved GDScript to review in place of the file on disk

detail.description: brief (capped lists) or full (everything); default brief

file.description: res:// path the code belongs to (required with code)

files.description: only show findings in these res:// files

from.description: release it comes from (default: the version saved in project.godot)

only_new.description: show only what changed since the last review of this project (saves tokens in a fix loop)

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

target.description: Godot release the project moves to, "4.1" to "4.7" (default 4.7)

name: godot_review
title: AAA review
